data.one_liner: Vector Font Icons for Flutter, including icon sets from react-native-vector-icons and WeatherIcons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of vector font icon sets, such as AntDesign, FontAwesome, Ionicons, and MaterialCommunityIcons, for use in Flutter applications. It also includes an IconToggle widget for switching between icons with animations.
use_when: You need a large variety of icon sets like FontAwesome, MaterialCommunityIcons, or Ionicons in your Flutter app.
You want an easy way to transition between selected and unselected states using the IconToggle widget.
avoid_when: Your project uses a version of Flutter older than 3.22.0.
You only need standard Material icons and want to avoid adding extra font dependencies.
strengths: Bundles many popular icon sets (AntDesign, FontAwesome, Ionicons, etc.) into a single package.
Includes an IconToggle widget with built-in transition animations.
weaknesses: May increase app bundle size due to the large number of bundled font files.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_font_icons to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need FontAwesome icons with dedicated maintenance and updates.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean Lucide icon set.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Google's Material Symbols.
